title: AMLR Cash Limit & EDD Classifier
description: Classify cash transactions against AMLR (Reg (EU) 2024/1624) Art. 80 €10,000 cash limit and Enhanced Due Diligence triggers. Identifies structuring risk and mandatory ID thresholds. Applies 10 Jul 2027.
